title: iammatthias.com developer documentation
lede: This site makes its content available in machine-readable form. It is public and free. There is no account, API key, or paid tier.
quickstart:
# Search the site
curl "https://iammatthias.com/api/search.json?q=cloudflare+workers"

# List one section
curl "https://iammatthias.com/api/content.json?section=recipes"

# Read a document as markdown
curl "https://iammatthias.com/posts/1779066375000-farfield.md"

# The whole corpus in one request
curl "https://iammatthias.com/llms-full.txt"

endpoints.label: GET /api/search-corpus.json
endpoints.description: Every searchable item on the site (documents and feed posts) as compact text, each carrying its Farfield content hash (cid). Intended for building your own index; the site's own search embeds this locally in the browser.

endpoints.label: GET /api/search-vectors.json
endpoints.description: Precomputed embedding vectors for the corpus, keyed by cid, with the model name and dimension count. Built at deploy time with the ternlight model.

endpoints.label: GET /api/content.json
endpoints.description: Every published document as structured JSON: title, section, tags, dates, content hash, canonical URL, and markdown URL. Filterable by section and tag.

endpoints.label: GET /api/search.json
endpoints.description: Ranked keyword search over titles, excerpts, tags, and body text of every published document. Returns canonical and markdown URLs per hit.

sections.title: HTTP endpoints
sections.body: The full specification is at [openapi.json](/openapi.json). Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. Each one has a `resolution` field that says how to retry.

sections.title: MCP server
sections.body:
The MCP server uses Streamable HTTP at `https://iammatthias.com/mcp`. It does not require authentication. Add it to any MCP client:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "iammatthias": { "url": "https://iammatthias.com/mcp" } } }
```

- `search_site`: Search Matthias Jordan's writing, photography notes, and recipes by keyword. Returns titles, excerpts, and both HTML and markdown URLs.
- `get_document`: Fetch the full markdown source of one document by its path or slug, with front matter (title, dates, tags, content hash) and images resolved to public URLs.
- `list_sections`: List the site's publications (art, posts, recipes, melange, experiments) with descriptions and entry counts.
- `list_recent`: List the most recently published documents, newest first, optionally filtered to one section.

Preview the tools without connecting: [server-card.json](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

sections.title: Markdown twins
sections.body: Every content URL has a markdown twin at the same path plus `.md`. It includes front matter with the title, dates, tags, content hash, and canonical URL. Images resolve to public URLs. Section indexes are at `/<section>.md`. Each section has scoped context at `/<section>/llms.txt`.

sections.title: Versioning
sections.body: The API is versioned under `/api/v1`: `/api/v1/search.json` and `/api/v1/content.json` are version-pinned aliases of the query endpoints, and every API response carries an `API-Version` header. Breaking changes will be announced here, in [/developers](/developers).

sections.title: Everything else
sections.body:
- [llms.txt site map](https://iammatthias.com/llms.txt): Index of every published document with links to its markdown twin.
- [Full corpus in one file](https://iammatthias.com/llms-full.txt): Every published document, front matter included, in a single markdown file.
- [iammatthias.com MCP server](https://iammatthias.com/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP server exposing site search and document retrieval as tools. No authentication required.
- [GraphQL endpoint](https://iammatthias.com/graphql): Typed, introspectable GraphQL over the same content: search, list, and read documents in one round trip. Relay connections, schema-modeled errors, no authentication.
- [GraphQL schema (SDL)](https://iammatthias.com/schema.graphql): The GraphQL schema as SDL, for codegen or reading without an introspection query.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://iammatthias.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the site's public read-only JSON endpoints.
- [XML sitemap](https://iammatthias.com/sitemap.xml): Every indexable URL with last-modified dates.
- [RSS feed](https://iammatthias.com/rss.xml): Sitewide RSS with full article bodies; per-section feeds at /<section>/rss.xml.

sections.title: Caching and etiquette
sections.body: Every record has a `cid`, which is a CIDv1 content hash. The same cid means the same bytes, forever. Cache against it instead of fetching the record again. Prefer [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) to crawling page by page. Send a descriptive `User-Agent`. The source is at [github.com/iammatthias/com](https://github.com/iammatthias/com).

sections.title: FAQ
sections.body:
**Does the iammatthias.com API require authentication?**

No. Every endpoint, feed, and MCP tool is public and anonymous. Do not send an Authorization header; it is ignored.

**What does the iammatthias.com API cost?**

Nothing. There is no account, no API key, and no paid tier. Rate limits are Cloudflare's edge defaults.

**Does iammatthias.com have an MCP server?**

Yes, at https://iammatthias.com/mcp over Streamable HTTP with no authentication. It exposes search_site, get_document, list_sections, list_recent.

**How do I get a page from iammatthias.com as markdown?**

Append .md to any content URL. The whole corpus is available in one request at https://iammatthias.com/llms-full.txt.

**Can I use content from iammatthias.com for AI training?**

No. The site's Content-Signal policy is search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no. Quoting with attribution and a link to the canonical URL is welcome.
